# Original Phase 1 geometric face

Created locally on 2026-11-02 by `scripts/create_phase1_art.py`, using only
analytic ellipses and original solid colors. No external artwork, downloaded
test model, AI image service or model weights. No third-party character likeness
or image license is involved; the repository has not selected a general license.

The accepted fixture is **final/**: original PNGs and semantic placement manifest,
editable PSD, portable PSD2Live source, and complete runtime export. Its creation
used PSD2Live 3.6.7 through MCP. `rig-recipe.json` contains ordered editor operations,
not hand-edited rig data. Recreate under a fresh directory; never reuse opaque
state tokens from evidence logs. [Details and limitations](../../../docs/phase1-results.md).

Earlier `art/`, `face.psd`, `face.psd2live`, `export/` and `runtime/` preserve
intermediates. Their brow direction and expression composition differ from
the accepted final model; do not deploy these intermediates.

This is a functional geometric rig with 18 drawables, not finished anime artwork.
Do not infer facial reconstruction, text-talk quality, physical simulation or
arbitrary-angle robustness from this fixture.
